name: Shore Customs Car and Truck Accessories
old_description: Shore Customs is the Jersey Shore’s Premier Source for Professional Car & Truck Customization
about:
Shore Customs Car and Truck Accessories operates in Ocean Township, New Jersey, serving the Jersey Shore region as a vehicle customization shop. The business focuses on professional car and truck accessory installation and customization.

The shop provides a full line of automotive customization services including 3M ceramic coating, paint protection film, window tinting, auto detailing, audio systems and electronics (GPS, Pioneer radios, Sirius XM), remote start, radar detectors, auto security, rim repairs, powder coating, vinyl wraps, WeatherTech mats, Rhino Linings, lift kits, new rims and tires, tonneau covers, truck accessories, Jeep accessories, Front Runner outfitting, Kargo Master vehicle shelving, frame repair, and Katzkin leather and heated seating installations. Customers receive detailed project reports with a breakdown of services performed.

The company serves individual vehicle owners, including Jeep and truck enthusiasts, off-road adventurers, and commercial users needing vehicle shelving. Testimonials reference work on a 2018 Toyota Tacoma with Katzkin seat covers and heaters, as well as window tinting and remote start installations for daily drivers.

Shore Customs emphasizes transparent communication and careful, step-by-step work, guaranteeing customer satisfaction on completed projects. Financing is available up to $10,000 for larger customization jobs.
